answer: Follow the money upstream. Every new key must anchor itself with a small bond, and the ledger traces where that bond came from. When a plume of fresh keys all trace back to one funding wallet, they share a single reward slot instead of each drawing from the ocean of emission. Estimate, assuming a 10 POA bond: a 1,000-key farm locks 10,000 POA for one slot of pay. Tradeoff: honest newcomers funded by one generous mentor get lumped too, so a key can split off after 30 epochs of independent earning.
